clips.title: The story
paras: The Stoutlager Inn is the lively heart of Thelsamar and a primary haven for travelers in Loch Modan. Tucked beneath the rolling hills of the loch, it offers warm hearths, strong dwarven ale, and a bustling gathering place for adventurers and locals alike.

Situated squarely in the settlement of Thelsamar, the Stoutlager Inn serves as the center of community life for western Loch Modan. Miners, mountaineers, and wayfarers passing between Dun Morogh and the Wetlands stop here to trade rumors, secure lodging, and share hearty drafts of dwarven brew. While the wilderness beyond Thelsamar grows increasingly hostile with trogg and kobold activity, the thick stone walls and roaring fires of the Stoutlager provide a dependable sanctuary.
